en.headline: Woman dies four days after being hit by FEHD contractor truck in North Point
en.dek: The 60-year-old pedestrian, surnamed Ng, was struck on 4 November near the Sunbeam Theatre; the 45-year-old driver has been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death.
body: A 60-year-old woman has died four days after being struck by a medium goods vehicle operated by a Food and Environmental Hygiene Department contractor in North Point.

Police said the accident occurred at about 10:11pm on 4 November on King's Road towards Shau Kei Wan, as the truck prepared to turn left into Shu Kuk Street near the former Sunbeam Theatre. The woman, surnamed Ng, suffered head injuries and was taken unconscious to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. She was certified dead at 12:14pm on Sunday.

The 45-year-old male driver, surnamed Lam, was arrested on Saturday on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death. He has been released on bail and must report to police in early December. Sources indicated his breath alcohol test result was zero at the time.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said the vehicle belonged to a contractor and was driven by a contractor employee. The department said it had contacted the contractor and requested a detailed accident report. The case has been passed to the Hong Kong Island traffic special investigation team.

zh.headline: 北角食環外判貨車撞倒60歲女途人 留醫四日不治 司機涉危駕致死被捕
zh.dek: 姓吳女子上月4日晚在新光戲院對開被撞，周日中午證實死亡；45歲姓林司機涉危險駕駛引致他人死亡，已保釋候查。
body: 一名60歲女子在北角被食物環境衞生署承辦商中型貨車撞倒，留醫四日後不治。
警方表示，意外於11月4日晚上約10時11分發生，貨車沿英皇道往筲箕灣方向行駛，準備左轉入書局街、前新光戲院對開時，撞倒正在過馬路的姓吳女子。她頭部受傷昏迷，送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院，於周日下午12時14分被證實死亡。
45歲姓林男司機周六涉嫌「危險駕駛引致他人死亡」被捕，其後獲准保釋，須於12月上旬向警方報到。消息指事發時其酒精呼氣測試結果為零。
食物環境衞生署表示，肇事車輛屬承辦商所有，由承辦商司機駕駛，署方已聯絡承辦商了解情況並要求提交詳盡意外報告。案件已交港島交通特別調查組跟進。
